title: Dental PPO Plans Claim Line Adjudication

superseded_clauses: The allowance is the allowed_amount for the billed procedure, replaced by the alternate_allowed_amount when an alternate benefit applies: a posterior composite filling when posterior_composite_alternate_benefit is true, or a porcelain or ceramic crown on a molar (a tooth listed in molar_teeth) when molar_crown_alternate_benefit is true; such a line is paid with remark PAID_ALTERNATE_BENEFIT.

For an in_network line the member owes the allowed_amount minus the plan payment and the practice may not bill more; for an out_of_network line the member owes the submitted_amount minus the plan payment.
